newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list Doubletree, Excite options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list Doubletree, Excite options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Monday it would begin trading options on Doubletree Corp and Excite Inc on January 20.
It said Doubletree options would open with strike prices of 40, 45 and 50, with initial expirations in February, March, April and July. They would trade in the K-Mart Corp trading crowd, it said.
Shares of the hotel management company ended at 43-5/8, down 1-1/8 on Monday.
CBOE said Excite options would have opening strikes of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2. Initial expirations would be in February, March, May and August, it said.
Excite, which develops internet navigational services and products, rose 5/8 to 10-1/2.
TFM Investment Group has been named the Designated Primary Market Maker (DPM) for Excite options, the CBOE said.
